transcript: My refund to credit card was started on 17 October 2026. By which date should I have it?
reply: Refunds to card take 5 to 7 business days. A refund initiated on 17 October 2026 should therefore arrive between 24 October 2026 and 27 October 2026, counting business days (Monday to Saturday, skipping warehouse holidays).
